description: Any other looktap command line, or several separated by ";" — e.g. "launch com.example.app --ls", "stop com.example.app", "open myapp://home", "expect Welcome", "zoom in", "appearance dark", "rotate landscape", "fold open", "record start demo" … "record stop", "permission grant location com.example.app", "perf com.example.app --for 10s", "launch com.example.app --time", "apps com.example" (is it installed?), "app com.example.app --paths" (its data folder), "devices --all", "boot Pixel_9a" (also waits for one still starting), "shutdown Pixel_9a". See: help.

device.description: Simulator UDID or adb serial, when several are booted. Remembered for later calls

platform.description: When both an iOS and an Android device are booted. Remembered for later calls

name: looktap
